title: GET /v1/site response body
description: Spec IV.5. Geometry field names are the spec names phi_s_deg, lambda_s_deg and h_s_m, not the issue names lat, lon and alt_m. The spec enumerates the rest of the body in prose without field names, so this object stays open rather than inventing names. operating_hours is untyped in both sources, so it admits a string or an object.

phi_s_deg.description: Site latitude in degrees. Spec value 45.3.

lambda_s_deg.description: Site longitude in degrees, negative west. Spec value -61.0.

source.description: Source of the corridor bounds, requirement 1 provenance.

flag.description: ASSUMPTION where the environmental assessment is qualitative.

operating_hours.description: Nominal operating hours, 07:00 to 12:00 local. Type left open: neither source states it.

car_references.description: Canadian Aviation Regulations references. The spec names 602.43 and 602.44; the list is not frozen so that a further citation does not break the contract.
